Soul Gas (requires Essence 3 to install) — victims roll Stamina + Resistance (difficulty 1 for magical beings, 4 for mortals); failure costs a temporary dot from every Virtue except Compassion and forces a Valor roll (difficulty 2), and failing that roll causes the victim to flee at best speed and suffer a one-die penalty to non-reflexive actions for an hour; a filter reduces the difficulty by 1.
cost: Varies (motes spent shape the cloud's size, capped at Manipulation per turn); Installation Cost: 1 mote.
compatibility: Duration: Instant (the resulting cloud persists per the duration rules above). Type: Reflexive. Close Combat Charms tree (Manipulation-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Close Combat Charms' tree, pp. 98-100 (PDF 99-101); visually cross-checked against the Close Combat Charms IV tree diagram. Spans three printed pages due to the four named gas submodules.

name: Perfected Lotus Matrix
summary: A skull-mounted memory-crystal port that lets an Alchemical learn and use ordinary Terrestrial or Celestial Martial Arts Charms the same way any other Celestial Exalt would, storing them independently of Charm Slots; the mandatory prerequisite for any Alchemical who wants to be a supernatural martial artist.
requirements: Minimum Martial Arts 2; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: None. Because it is not Attribute-based, this Charm is never Favored or Caste for any Alchemical and must occupy a General Charm Slot.
mechanics: Enables the Alchemical to comprehend and learn Terrestrial- or Celestial-level Martial Arts Charms exactly as any other Celestial Exalted, at a cost of 6 bonus points or 11 xp each; these Charms need no Charm Slots of their own, instead stored as submodule-like programs in the Matrix's memory crystals. Master sifus may even develop entirely new styles as Solar Exalted can (Exalted Players Guide, p. 232). Removing the Perfected Lotus Matrix suspends access to every Martial Arts Charm stored in it until it is reinstalled. Alchemical martial artists may still build ordinary Combos of their Martial Arts Charms at the usual cost and difficulty, but cannot mix in their Attribute-based Charms.
compatibility: Duration: N/A. Type: Permanent. Close Combat Charms tree (Martial Arts-keyed; General Slot only).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Close Combat Charms' tree, p. 100 (PDF 101). This is the specific Charm referenced by name in the pre-existing alchemical-bonus-points-and-experience-costs row's Martial Arts Charm cost line.

name: Alchemical Martial Artists (available Autochthonian styles)
summary: A short sidebar noting that Vat Complexes preserve records of numerous Terrestrial and Celestial martial arts styles — including Creation's animal styles and native Autochthonian techniques developed for Alchemicals using advanced cognitive Charms — and lists the specific published styles Alchemical characters may take via the Perfected Lotus Matrix.
mechanics: Available styles (or indistinguishable local variants) explicitly listed: Snake, Tiger, Mantis, Ebon Shadow, Celestial Monkey, Righteous Devil, Violet Bier of Sorrows, Five Dragon, and Jade Mountain.
compatibility: All Alchemical castes with the Perfected Lotus Matrix installed.
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Alchemical Martial Artists' sidebar, p. 100 (PDF 101). Classified reference-only rather than selectable because it is a curated style-availability list, not a discrete purchasable Trait of its own; the styles' actual Charms are standard published Martial Arts Charms outside this book's scope, while Perfected Lotus Matrix is the selectable row that grants access to them.

name: Aim-Calibrating Sensors
summary: A forehead-mounted rangefinder and targeting implant that strips environmental and situational penalties away from an Alchemical's ranged attacks.
requirements: Minimum Perception 2; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: None.
mechanics: For every mote spent, remove one die of environmental or situational penalty from a ranged attack roll (range, wind, cover short of 100%, shields, low light, and similar factors); every 2 motes instead cancel one point of a difficulty increase or prevent one post-roll success from being subtracted. Does not offset wound penalties, fear-based penalties, multiple-action penalties, or other non-environmental penalties; the Storyteller remains final arbiter of what qualifies.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Supplemental. Ranged Combat Charms tree (Perception-keyed); root Charm of the tree.
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Ranged Combat Charms' tree, p. 100 (PDF 101); visually cross-checked against the Ranged Combat Charms tree diagram, confirming it as the tree's root prerequisite.

name: Paramagnetic Tether Beam
summary: A finger-mounted device that projects a ray of telekinetic force, letting an Alchemical crudely manipulate, grab, disarm, or even hang and winch herself along an intangible line using raw Essence in place of Strength and Dexterity.
requirements: Minimum Strength 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Aim-Calibrating Sensors.
mechanics: Projects a single beam up to (Strength x 10) yards, lasting as long as it is consciously directed (activating a new beam cancels the old one). Substitutes Essence for both Dexterity and Strength for telekinetic manipulation, with normal Abilities still supplying finesse (feats of strength performed with the beam use Essence + Athletics to determine maximum force). Recalling a thrown weapon or grabbing a loose one is Essence + the appropriate combat Ability; disarming a foe's weapon (not usable against attuned magical weapons still held by their owners) requires Essence + Brawl or Martial Arts; seizing a disarmed weapon off the ground requires a separate Dexterity + Brawl/Martial Arts roll declared as a multiple action. Other feats include hanging suspended by the tether beam or winching oneself up along it.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Reflexive. Ranged Combat Charms tree (Strength-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Ranged Combat Charms' tree, pp. 100-101 (PDF 101-102); visually cross-checked against the Ranged Combat Charms tree diagram.

name: Essence Pulse Cannon
summary: A built-in arm-, shoulder-, palm-, or eye-mounted energy weapon firing bolts of anima-colored plasma, with by far the deepest submodule catalog of any Alchemical Charm — ten named upgrades covering stealth, accuracy, ammo reserves, piercing fire, knockback, nonlethal fire, area blasts, Essence-draining, soul-destroying annihilation, and a devastating siege mode.
requirements: Minimum Strength 4; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Aim-Calibrating Sensors.
mechanics: Arming the cannon (2 motes, an automatic action like drawing any other sheathed weapon) makes it hum and glow, displaying like an anima banner at the 4-7 mote range and interfering with stealth/disguise. Active statistics: fires with Dexterity + Archery; range (Essence x 50) yards; accuracy +1; rate (Essence x number of installations); damage 2L per mote spent powering the blast (capped at Strength + Essence motes per shot); each shot counts as a supplemental Charm use; bolts have no physical component but are dodgeable/parriable normally. Ten submodules (2 bonus points/6 xp each, freely combinable unless stated otherwise): Discreet (hidden eye/palm mount, +1 difficulty to detect while inactive, displays only at the 1-3 mote range when firing); Guidance Ray (free reflexive on/off, +3 accuracy but grants the target +1 die to dodge/parry via the visible tracer beam); Internal Battery (adds an 8-mote reserve usable only to fire this Charm; refilling costs 2 motes from the main Essence pool per simple action; only one battery permitted); Precision Beam (-2 raw damage dice but the bolt becomes piercing; incompatible with detonation or shockwave); Shockwave (damage capped at one level per hit, but knocks human-sized-or-smaller targets back one yard per die of post-soak raw damage, dealing extra collision damage and forcing a knockdown check at difficulty 2); Stunning Bolt (3B per mote instead of lethal damage; excess damage past Incapacitated does not spill over); Detonation (requires Essence 3; 1L per mote to the direct target, plus a spreading blast dealing base damage at 1 yard and losing a die per further yard; combinable with shockwave for outward knockback); Essence Dampening Bolt / Energy Drain (requires Essence 3 / Essence 4 for the Energy Drain variant; deals lethal damage plus an Essence bonus but only permanent-Essence soak applies, draining 1 mote of the target's Essence per level of damage — feeding an Exalted target's own anima banner in the base version, or refilling the Alchemical's own Essence pool in the Energy Drain variant; incompatible with shockwave, stunning bolt, precision beam, or pattern disruptor); Pattern Disruptor (requires Essence 4; 1A per mote, halves other base-damage bonuses rounded down, disintegrates whatever it kills or destroys, permanently annihilates slain spirits, and obliterates mortal souls unless the victim carries an implanted soulgem; incompatible with detonation, shockwave, or stunning bolt); Siege Devastator (requires Essence 5; reflexive on/off but a full turn to ready or stow, replacing a forearm/hand entirely, dropping rate to 1, imposing a -2 mobility penalty cumulative with armor, and displaying like an anima banner at the 8-10 mote range, in exchange for +1 raw damage die per mote regardless of other modifications used, i.e. 3L per mote unmodified).
cost: 2 motes (base activation; submodule effects layer on top per shot); Installation Cost: 1 mote.
compatibility: Duration: Indefinite. Type: Supplemental. Ranged Combat Charms tree (Strength-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Ranged Combat Charms' tree, pp. 101-103 (PDF 102-104); visually cross-checked against the Ranged Combat Charms tree diagram. This is the largest single Charm write-up encountered in this pass; flagged for future re-verification of the exact mutual-exclusion matrix among the Essence Dampening Bolt/Energy Drain and Pattern Disruptor submodules given how many combination restrictions the text lists.

name: Interceptor Spark Emitter
summary: An Essence Pulse Cannon upgrade Charm that lets an Alchemical shoot incoming missiles out of the air, either against a single tracked projectile or, in a full defensive-trance mode, against every ranged attack aimed at her that turn.
requirements: Minimum Wits 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Essence Pulse Cannon (need not be actively armed to use this Charm).
mechanics: First mode (2 motes): reflexively target and fire at a single missile within (Essence x 50) yards that the Exalt is aware of, rolling Dexterity + Archery + Essence as a parry (adding a die if using the cannon's guidance ray upgrade); defending someone else instead of himself raises the parry's difficulty by 3. A full success destroys physical missiles or dissipates energy attacks; artifact projectiles are deflected harmlessly, most mortal weapons are heat-warped to uselessness, and other extremely durable objects may qualify for protection at Storyteller discretion. Cannot target anything notably larger than a javelin unless the Alchemical is Essence 6+, which removes the size limit entirely. Second mode (3 motes, usable only if the Exalt has not yet acted that turn): a full parry against every ranged attack she perceives and wishes to block that turn, at her full Dexterity + Archery + Essence pool per attack (including defending others at +3 difficulty), but she cannot abort the trance to defend against hand-to-hand attacks or otherwise act that turn.
cost: 2 motes or 3 motes; Installation Cost: None.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Reflexive. Ranged Combat Charms tree (Wits-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Ranged Combat Charms' tree, pp. 103-104 (PDF 104-105); visually cross-checked against the Ranged Combat Charms tree diagram.

name: Pulseweb Entanglement Burst
summary: An Essence Pulse Cannon upgrade that fires a compressed net of Essence instead of a bolt, trapping a target in a crystalline aura that both restrains and lightly protects them while the Alchemical maintains the field turn after turn.
requirements: Minimum Strength 5; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Essence Pulse Cannon.
mechanics: Fired with Dexterity + Archery (no default accuracy bonus, though the cannon's guidance ray or internal battery upgrades still apply; no other cannon modification may be used); range increment (Essence x 20) yards. On hitting an animate target, an opposed Strength + Essence roll decides the outcome: if the Alchemical wins, the target is paralyzed for the rest of the turn as if held in a clinch, with the committed motes locked until the aura breaks; if the victim wins, the field shatters harmlessly. Each subsequent turn, a fresh reflexive contested Strength + Essence roll (independent of either character's action, continuing even if either is unconscious) decides whether the aura holds — dealing 1 unsoakable bashing level per turn held, stopping once the victim is Incapacitated but still restraining her — or shatters, freeing the target to act if conscious. The Alchemical may voluntarily dissipate the web at any time. The aura reduces the raw damage of any attack against the trapped victim by the Alchemical's Essence rating (potentially to zero) and inflicts the Alchemical's Essence in dice of piercing bashing damage on anyone striking the entrapped victim in hand-to-hand combat.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Simple. Ranged Combat Charms tree (Strength-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Ranged Combat Charms' tree, p. 104 (PDF 105); visually cross-checked against the Ranged Combat Charms tree diagram.

name: Protosynthetic Ammunition Replicator
summary: A forearm-mounted implant that manufactures short-lived but fully solid Essence ammunition on demand — arrows of several head types, throwing daggers, batons, or chakrams — automatically feeding a carried bow as needed.
requirements: Minimum Dexterity 2; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Aim-Calibrating Sensors.
mechanics: Each activation creates one projectile of the Exalt's choice (target, frog crotch, fowling or broadhead arrow; throwing dagger; throwing baton; or a chakram whose interlocking blades unfold into something resembling a buzz saw); arrows are automatically fed/notched into a carried bow via an internal tendril for instant firing. Manufactured ammunition is fully solid and functions normally, but dissipates back into wisps of light after a number of turns equal to the creator's Essence. Ammunition scales to the Alchemical's build, so Essence 6+ Exalted generate warstrider-scaled missiles.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Reflexive. Ranged Combat Charms tree (Dexterity-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Ranged Combat Charms' tree, pp. 104-105 (PDF 105-106); visually cross-checked against the Ranged Combat Charms tree diagram.

name: Repeating Pneumatic Bow
summary: A forearm-integrated, steam-and-Essence-powered automatic bow that draws ammunition straight from the Alchemical's Protosynthetic Ammunition Replicator, upgradeable with a targeting ray or a self-contained arrow magazine.
requirements: Minimum Strength 3; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Protosynthetic Ammunition Replicator.
mechanics: Statistics: base damage Strength (as modified by its ammunition), accuracy equal to Essence, range increment (100 x Essence) yards, unlimited rate; the weapon visibly hisses and thrums when active, making it obvious to onlookers as a dangerous magical weapon. Must draw arrows from the Ammunition Replicator's internal clip; firing the bow itself does not count as a separate Charm activation. Submodules (2 bonus points/6 xp each, freely combinable): Guidance Ray (duplicates the Essence Pulse Cannon submodule of the same name); Internal Magazine (stores up to 6 arrows generated via the Replicator inside a stasis field that halts their disintegration until they are fired that turn, letting the character feed the weapon from either the replicator or the magazine as desired).
compatibility: Duration: Indefinite. Type: Reflexive. Ranged Combat Charms tree (Strength-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Ranged Combat Charms' tree, p. 105 (PDF 106); visually cross-checked against the Ranged Combat Charms tree diagram.

name: Subluminous Onslaught Missile
summary: An upgrade to the Repeating Pneumatic Bow that fires a mile-ranged, near-unparriable spike of crystallized Essence with devastating piercing damage and a concussive shockwave that can send victims flying.
requirements: Minimum Strength 5; Minimum Essence 4; Prerequisite Charms: Repeating Pneumatic Bow.
mechanics: Fired with the Exalt's full Dexterity + Archery; accuracy equals Essence; range increment one mile; base damage [Strength + (Essence x 2)]L, piercing, and cannot be parried without a stunt or Charm. On dealing damage, the missile loses one raw-damage die and continues flying in a straight line until it fails to inflict further damage. A concussive shockwave follows the missile, knocking human-sized-or-smaller victims back one foot per die of post-soak damage; victims who strike a solid surface instead of skidding to a halt take 1B per remaining yard of travel (potentially lethal against a hazardous surface).
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Simple. Ranged Combat Charms tree (Strength-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Ranged Combat Charms' tree, p. 105 (PDF 106); visually cross-checked against the Ranged Combat Charms tree diagram.

name: Hundredfold Strafing Methodology
summary: A Repeating Pneumatic Bow upgrade that sweeps a wide arc with a continuous stream of Essence darts, striking every target — friend or foe — caught in the swath with a single attack roll.
requirements: Minimum Dexterity 5; Minimum Essence 4; Prerequisite Charms: Repeating Pneumatic Bow (must already be deployed to activate this Charm, though it generates its own ammunition independent of the Ammunition Replicator).
mechanics: The Exalt specifies an arc width up to 90 degrees and sweeps her arm across it; for the remainder of the turn, the bow fires a constant stream of darts (existing until the end of the turn) cutting through every target in the path. The player rolls Dexterity + Archery once and applies the result to every target caught in the swath. The darts have a 100-yard range increment and inflict a base lethal damage equal to Essence. Outside combat, the Charm can generally cut down large amounts of vegetation or obstacles in a single sweep.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Extra Action. Ranged Combat Charms tree (Dexterity-keyed).
notes: Chapter Three: Charms, 'Ranged Combat Charms' tree, pp. 105-106 (PDF 106-107); visually cross-checked against the Ranged Combat Charms tree diagram.

name: Transmodal Rapid Targeting System
summary: A neural-tattoo implant letting an Alchemical either bounce a single projectile through a cascading series of targets or unleash a near-simultaneous volley of separate missiles at multiple foes.
requirements: Minimum Dexterity 5; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Aim-Calibrating Sensors.
mechanics: First mode (3 motes per additional target): a single projectile is fired or thrown at an initial target, then — whether it hit or missed — the player selects a new target and rolls again at full pool for another 3 motes, repeating up to a total of (Essence + 1) attacks with no target struck twice; the Exalt may pay 1 mote at any point to recall the projectile to hand instead of leaving it lodged in the final target. All targets in a cascade must be traceable in range from the Exalt, with range penalties shifting per normal rules, and weapons with a single maximum range and no increments (such as firewands) require every target within that radius. Combining the retargeting mode with Essence Pulse Cannon in a Combo pays the Essence cost only once and carries submodule effects consistently to every target (a detonation submodule only triggers on the final hit); combining it with Repeating Pneumatic Bow requires a Combo with Protosynthetic Ammunition Replicator but only pays that Charm's cost once; it cannot be Comboed with Paramagnetic Tether Beam, Pulseweb Entanglement Burst, Subluminous Onslaught Missile, or any other Charm the Storyteller rules illogical. Second mode (same cost and rules): fires distinct missiles at superhuman speed instead of one recycled projectile, requiring separate ammunition per shot, unable to recall projectiles, and able to strike the same target multiple times; when Comboed with Essence Pulse Cannon each bolt is paid for and configured separately, and Protosynthetic Ammunition Replicator must be reactivated per shot; this volley mode may be Comboed with any Charm barred from the retargeting mode.
cost: 3 motes per target; Installation Cost: 2 motes.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Extra Action. Ranged Combat Charms tree (Dexterity-keyed).

name: Dedicated Harmonic Targeting
summary: A sensor-lock Charm used with the Transmodal Rapid Targeting System that dematerializes a fired projectile so it ignores all cover and can never strike an unintended bystander, rematerializing only as it reaches its true target.
requirements: Minimum Perception 3; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Transmodal Rapid Targeting System.
mechanics: Locks onto a single currently-perceived target's unique Essence signature and imprints it on a fired or thrown projectile, which becomes translucent and physically ignores all intervening cover, shields, and obstacles (removing associated penalties) and cannot hit a bystander even on the worst botch. It rematerializes just before striking its intended target, so worn armor still protects normally. If the projectile fails to strike its target by the end of the turn, it either disintegrates (most objects) or teleports back to its owner's hand (attuned artifacts). May be used to snipe a target through an intervening wall, provided the Alchemical has some way to perceive the victim through the barrier.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Supplemental. Ranged Combat Charms tree (Perception-keyed).
